questions.text: What does BCI identify as a main variable in steel connection strength?

options.text: Member sizes plus the tees, angles, plates, bolts, and weld configuration used
Paint color only
The date the beam was delivered
The number of rooms in the building

questions.rationale: BCI ties connection strength to member and connector size and bolt or weld configuration.
questions.explanation: Braced frames use axial force in diagonals, not bending. Floor decking carries gravity loads; lateral forces are in frame. MRF is not economical due to complex connections; braced frames are cheaper. MRF transfers lateral forces through bending moment at rigid beam-column connections. Advantages: architectural flexibility (open floor plans, no interior bracing). Disadvantages: require larger members for moment capacity, complex connections (welded or bolted moment plates), higher cost. Essential for ductility in seismic regions (Philippines).

questions.text: Which description best matches a moment connection in the checked source scope?

options.text: A connection intended to hold its angle under loading by developing resisting moment
A connection intended only to carry paint loads
A loose joint that is never engineered
A temporary shipping strap

questions.rationale: BCI distinguishes moment connections from simple shear connections by rigidity and moment resistance.

questions.text: What is true of a shear connection in simple steel framing?

options.text: It transfers shear and permits rotation under gravity loads, so lateral stability must come from another system
It automatically resists all building sway alone
It is the same as a full rigid joint
It removes the need for beams

questions.rationale: BCI states that simple frame shear connections require shear walls or diagonal bracing for lateral stability.

questions.text: What role does metal decking play during construction?

options.text: It can serve as a working platform and formwork for a site-cast concrete slab
It is only a finish paint layer
It replaces all structural beams
It is installed after occupancy only

questions.rationale: BCI describes corrugated metal decking as a platform and permanent formwork for slabs.
questions.explanation: Beams are installed after columns and bracing, not first. Fireproofing is installed after frame is complete and connections are verified. Decking cannot be installed before columns and beams support it. Correct sequence: (1) Erect columns from lowest level upward, (2) Install temporary bracing (diagonals, knee braces) to stabilize frame against wind/seismic, (3) Install floor beams and make connections (bolted or welded), (4) Install deck and concrete. Temporary bracing is critical to prevent instability and collapse during erection.

questions.text: How does composite decking differ from simple form decking in the checked source?

options.text: It bonds with the concrete slab and may work with shear studs for composite action
It is made of wood planks only
It is never attached to steel beams
It is a nonstructural wallpaper finish

questions.rationale: BCI explains composite decking as tensile reinforcement bonded to the slab with possible shear-stud interaction.
questions.explanation: Two MRFs add redundancy but do not reduce member sizes. Two braced systems are stiff but brittle; ductility is sacrificed. Precast elements do not enhance lateral system; this is tangential. Dual systems combine MRF (ductile, absorbs seismic energy elastically) with bracing (stiff, reduces lateral drift). MRF alone requires large members for moment capacity; bracing alone is brittle if poorly designed. Dual optimizes both seismic ductility (essential in Philippines per NSCP 2015) and stiffness, reducing member sizes and cost.

questions.text: What is the LEA trap in structural steel construction questions?

options.text: Confusing moment, shear, semi-rigid, joist, decking, and bracing roles
Assuming all connections are decorative
Treating steel decking as a roofing shingle only
Ignoring source locators for exact standard claims

questions.rationale: The checked article emphasizes system roles and connection behavior.
